mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with clear skies at Verona City Hall and a full moon.
The Finance Department has released the proposed 2027 budget, and the Plan Commission will meet on November 4th to review development projects like Ardent Glen and a site plan for 1979 Milky Way.

Enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by yoga tomorrow and several trivia nights starting on October 27th, plus don't miss the Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29th.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving, though thankfully no students were injured.
The flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl, and the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
